name: Max Weber
shortBio: German sociologist and political economist; formulated interpretive sociology (Verstehen), the Protestant Ethic thesis, ideal types, and the 'iron cage' of rationalization.
centralQuestion: How did Western rationalization, religious asceticism, and bureaucratic disenchantment trap modern humanity inside an iron cage of formal order?

keyWorks.title: The Protestant Ethic and the Spirit of Capitalism
keyWorks.description: Seminal thesis connecting Calvinist inner-worldly asceticism to capitalist rational enterprise.

keyWorks.title: Economy and Society
keyWorks.description: Monumental sociological treatise covering types of authority, law, religion, and bureaucracy.
